**Daily Devotional**

**May 31**

*9 But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him. 10 But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God. (1 Corinthians 2:9-10 KJV)*

Verse 9 is quoting Isaiah (Isaiah 64:4), and is telling us that we cannot know the things of God with our human understanding. That was shown to be so true when Satan and his demons crucified the Lord (2 Corinthians 2:8), as they would never have crucified Jesus if they could have understood that was God’s plan all along. It shows that the devil and man neither one can understand the things of God on our own, as His ways are so far above our ways.

Thank God for the Holy Spirit, as a born again Christian can now know and understand the things of God through the Holy Spirit. This revelation knowledge is in our new Spirits, and can be accessed by the believer through his faith in Jesus. This bears out the proclamation of Jeremiah when he said that man was not to guide his own footsteps (Jeremiah 10:23). We have been so very, very, blessed by the Father in sending His love through Jesus to bring us back into fellowship with Himself (John 17:3). Thank you God, thank you Jesus, thank you Holy Spirit. Amen.
